protocol.browserCache: Disabled through CDP; fresh browser context for every trial
protocol.playback: Unthrottled: seven seconds from t42; throttled: complete sequence from t0
protocol.note: The added latency is the CDP latency parameter. This local test does not measure public hosting, DNS, TLS or real-world mobile graphics.
protocol.server: Isolated local static HTTP server, no-store, byte ranges, gzip text; binary media/models unchanged

limitations: One trial per variant/profile by default; results are exploratory, not statistically stable benchmarks.
CPU render-submission times and display callbacks are not GPU execution times.
Initial transferred bytes include HTML, CSS, scripts, manifest, poster and media/model traffic received up to readiness; the complete media file need not be downloaded.
The slow profile includes full playback; detailed screenshots and seven-second decoder samples use the local profile.
A new browser context clears page/media caches, but operating-system file caches and GPU driver shader caches can remain warm.
Pixel differences between variants include compression, foliage resolution and any scene-rendering differences. They are not a perceptual quality verdict.
The new bake and the original film can have different wind phase after the material transition. Bare-timber source/client comparisons isolate camera/material alignment.

checks: Direct hybrid link preserves requested time
Switching all versions preserves the moment
Play, pause and scrub work and remain paused
Rapid replacement cancels stale hybrid loading
Mobile layout has no page overflow
